accepted: Owner, 7 November 2026: D5 (the bar as proposed), D12 (bar 3 denominator), D19 (gate declines count against bar 3), D22 (standard metrics with 95% intervals), D23 (the median of the 24 costs is the upper median)
committed: A1 of #416, before any tuning run; pinned by SHA-256 in BarPinTests so it cannot change before A4

held_out.run_by: the frozen prompt, model, route and checks, after this bar is committed (T7)

definitions.wrong_value: A value at Confirm that differs from the transcription under scorer v2.
definitions.silent_error_table: A table with a wrong value that carries no attention item.
definitions.not_read_row: A printed row the model omits. It is shown as missing, never as zero, and is not a wrong value. It does make the table need an edit.
definitions.no_edit: No correction and no entry. Taps confirming that a value matches the text on attention items are allowed and counted.
definitions.outcome: Each held-out label ends as exactly one of reached_confirm, failed or declined, and the three add up to 24. A gate or detector decline after a valid model reply counts as declined (D19).
definitions.hard_decline: Gate G1 or G2, a panel detector decline, or a mapping that leaves no usable table (D19). Gate findings G3 to G6 travel to Confirm as flags or attention items.
definitions.reached_confirm: A table the product would show at Confirm.
definitions.cost: Per tap, including retries, the reported cost. An unknown cost is counted at the per-tap cap. Measured over all 24 taps.
definitions.latency: Per tap, from the tap to Confirm or failure, including retries, over all 24 taps.
definitions.copy_method: The copy method recorded in each label's collection record.

gates.reason: The shipped reader declines every UK paste (D12).

gates.median_definition: The upper median, the 13th of the 24 sorted values (owner, D23).

reported_not_gating: results by tier, with tier A on its own as the independent figure
rule-of-three upper limits with the real counts, as in P4
the exposure already known about the held-out set (5.1), beside the counts
zero silent errors in 24 tables still allows a true rate of up to about 14% (two-sided 95%)

macro_averages.precision: Averaged over the labels that reach Confirm; the count of labels excluded is reported beside it.
macro_averages.recall_and_f1: Averaged over all labels; a failed or declined label scores 0 on both.

comparing_versions.data: tuning set only, on the same labels
comparing_versions.report: the number of versions compared, with the winner; no held-out label informs the choice

on_miss: A miss stops release. The held-out set is then spent and becomes tuning data.
